title: BANDIQNodeAgentConfig
description: Configuration schema for BANDIQ DePIN Bandwidth Node Agent

software_version.description: Version string of the BANDIQ agent binary

data_dir.description: Path to persistent local agent storage (keys, spool queue, consent)

wallet_address.description: Operator EVM wallet address on Sidra Chain to associate with this node

consent_given.description: Whether explicit operator consent has been recorded

target_chain_id.description: Target blockchain network chain ID (97453 for Sidra Chain)

token_contract_address.description: BNDQ token contract address on Sidra Chain

verify_chain_on_startup.description: Whether to query and verify eth_chainId on node startup

test_interval_sec.description: Frequency in seconds between automated tests (e.g. 900 for 15 mins)

max_test_duration_sec.description: Maximum test duration limit in seconds to prevent pipe hogging

max_data_per_test_mb.description: Maximum data volume transferred per benchmark

daily_data_cap_mb.description: Daily bandwidth cap in megabytes. Tests automatically halt when exceeded

max_bandwidth_limit_mbps.description: Bandwidth speed throttle in Mbps to protect home ISP connection

test_servers.description: List of authorized test server endpoints

report_interval_sec.description: Frequency of flushing offline spooled reports

spool_dir.description: Path to persistent offline spool directory

max_spool_reports.description: Maximum queued reports retained during network outages

bind_address.description: Localhost loopback bind address (remote binding strictly forbidden by default)
